prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate change to a 3D-IC physical design flow.
Hypothesis of the change: The parent (c003) clamps the per-region density weight at 5 and slows its growth, which eases buffer insertion but leaves residual overlap in dense regions; instead of only capping the weight, make the update *stop earlier* by raising the per-region stop criterion slightly (so regions that are already nearly overflow-free stop inflating their density penalty) while keeping the gentler 1.02/1.03 growth — this reduces over-spreading in already-clean regions (helps bp_fe which regressed) without removing the whitespace benefit ariane133/bp gained.
Rule-based digest:
total=+0.312 robust(mean-std)=+0.081 min_case=+0.088 all_valid=True
  ariane133-ng45: score=+0.088 dWNS=+4.4% dTNS=+11.5% overflow~160
  bp-ng45: score=+0.088 dWNS=+16.5% dTNS=+3.3% overflow~99
  bp_fe-ng45: score=+0.136 dWNS=+1.2% dTNS=+21.7% overflow~141
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID (failures listed), first say what kind of failure it is (legality / crash / timeout) and whether it looks systematic (all seeds of a case) or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which case/metric moved and plausible mechanism, (3) one concrete next-step suggestion. No preamble.

response: The hypothesis held: raising the per-region stop criterion while keeping gentle 1.02/1.03 growth improved all three cases (robust +0.081, min +0.088, all valid). bp_fe recovered (+0.136, dTNS +21.7%), consistent with reduced over-spreading in already-clean regions; ariane133 (+0.088, dWNS +4.4%) and bp (+0.088, dWNS +16.5%) retained whitespace benefit. Next step: sweep the stop-criterion threshold (e.g., 1.02/1.03 vs 1.05/1.06) to find the knee balancing bp_fe recovery against ariane/bp overflow gains.
